skills.description: Valid skills discovered at the source URL.

display_name.description: Skill name parsed from SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Skill description parsed from SKILL.md frontmatter.

source_url.description: Resolved URL for this skill within the source.

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA used to produce the preview.

main_content.description: SKILL.md content fetched as part of the preview.

files.description: Supporting files fetched with the skill.

path.description: Relative path within the skill bundle.

file_tree.description: Relative paths discovered for the skill.

failures.description: Discovered entries that could not be included in the preview.

source_url.description: Resolved URL for the entry that could not be previewed.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason a discovered entry was excluded.
code.title: PlatformSkillSourcePreviewFailureCode

detail.description: Safe explanation of why the entry was excluded.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

schema.description:
Server-sent scan, progress, skill, and result events. A failed stream
emits `data: {"type":"error","code":"service_unavailable","message":"GitHub is temporarily unavailable."}`
followed by `data: [DONE]` instead of a result event.

400.description: Invalid request (malformed JSON, invalid parameter values, unknown fields).

schema.description: Error response following RFC 9457, extended with `code` and `documentation_url` for machine-readable classification and self-service remediation.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored from the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.
detail.example: The provided cursor has expired. Start a new search to get a fresh cursor.

documentation_url.description: Direct URL to documentation for this error code.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

errors.description: Field-level validation problems, one entry per offending field.

items.description: Field-level validation problem for a single offending field.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the offending field.

detail.example: Must be one of: USER, GLEAN_AI.

items.title: PlatformProblemDetailError
